label: The genus principle at being only: whatever is maximal in being causes the being…, by Direct-proof
meaning: On the attribution order with strict primacy, whatever is maximal in being is the primary (by excluded middle: anything else falls short of the primary, so the primary would be more a being than it); the primary causes the being of every creature, and everything other than it is a creature; so the maximum causes the being of every other being.
